summary: Verified the 'Cost of the plan' card on Executive Overview for Northwind Trading Co. All expected numbers render exactly as specified: Monthly USD 3,370, One-off USD 12,000, Annualised USD 52,440, '11 of 12 agents and workflows costed · 1 without a number yet'. By-sourcing shows BUY 5 / BUILD 1 / HYBRID 5. Per-phase table: Phase 1 (7 items, USD 1,770 monthly, 1 uncosted), Phase 2 (4 items, USD 1,200 monthly, USD 12,000 one-off), Phase 3 (1 item, USD 400 monthly). Other Executive Overview cards (agents 11 / initiatives 9 / opportunities 15 / records 77, living-model flags, changes since last publication) still render without errors. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: costRollup() in ExecutiveOverview.jsx coerces unknown d.phase to Phase 1 bucket (`r.byPhase[d.phase] ? d.phase : 1`) — acceptable fallback, but may hide bad data.

money() returns '—' when n is 0 — matches 'missing never zero' contract, but if a user legitimately enters cost_estimate 0 and cost_period monthly, the phase monthly aggregate could still show '—' when rounded total is 0; low impact.
